Shooting Business Voice

My voice on a very short explainer video for Shooting business.

Shooting Business Voice

When I first got the script, I thought some of it was missing. Then I realised they really had been able to say everything concisely in such a compact way. In July I became the Shooting Business Voice on their explainer video. What I absolutely love about this video is, they said it all in 30 seconds. Short and concise. It really doesn't need any more to get the message across. Great animation and even if I do say so myself... great voice... With most of my other explainer videos, companies usually spend a minute or two explaining their message but this video illustrates perfectly that this just isn't always necessary. If you'd like to check out a couple more, watch my Rise Project explainer video.

So who are Shooting Business?

ShootingBusiness.com created compelling business videos. They were different to most other video production companies because they are driven by your underlying marketing requirements and desired business results. Only when they fully understood what you want to achieve, your target market and what makes you tick, did they work with you on the scripts for your compelling videos.
They are now closed.

Get in touch

So, if you require a voice for an explainer video or your very own website video, then please get in touch. To make the whole process easier, just send a sample of the script and the intended usage of the project and I can quote you more accurately. Feel free to send a short sample of the script so I can send you an audition for the part too.
